title: Review of c46's hunting-ecology controls: Supported. On fresh seed 16 the 256^2 predator-free twin is a static, growing prey emulsion (52 -> 78, 24 persistent splits) against 52 -> 4 -> 46 -> 24 prey with 0 persistent prey splits under predation, and a fuel cut at t=6000 (128^2) removes all 13 prey within 400 t while the fed run keeps 14
summary: Same world as the claim. Seed 16, 256^2, t=12000, --lineage-k 5: predator-free twin (pred_on 0) prey every 1000 t 6/43/52/52/52/52/52/52/53/55/65/75/78, 24 persistent prey splits (generation 2), no decline (sheet: round prey turning into dumbbells that pinch from t~6300); with predators (same seed and grid) prey 12/47/52/4/13/46/46/46/36/25/27/32/24 and predators 0/0/0/55/57/57/53/48/53/55/36/35/35, 0 persistent prey splits, 19 predator persistent splits (generation 2). Fuel fork at t=6000 (128^2, seed 16, labkit): prey 13 -> 9 -> 0 at t=6000/6200/6400 with mean prey material 0.237 -> 0.238, predators stay at 14-15; fed run (same seed) keeps 14 prey at t=6400 and 7000.

observations.X: twin256_s16 vs pack256_s16 (seed 16, 256^2): predator-free prey grow 52 -> 78 with 24 persistent splits; with predators prey fall to 4 by t~3000 and end at 24 with 0 persistent splits; efork128_s16: prey 13 -> 0 by t=6400 after the fuel cut while fed128_s16 keeps 14

seeds_run.result: pass for the twin contrast and the fork

controls_run.X: twin256_s16/ (pred_on 0) against pack256_s16/ (same seed and grid); efork128_s16/ (fork_t 6000) against fed128_s16/

verdicts.limitation: One fresh seed. Under predation the prey divide even less on this seed (0 persistent splits) than on the author's (2), so prey D under predation stays the weak point of the ecology claim. The fork is at 128^2, as in the finding; the with-predator arm at 256^2 ran with 1 thread, which does not change the numerics.
